source: Complete built-in command set from code.claude.com/docs/en/commands, fetched & enriched 2026-06-13 (117 commands incl. aliases).
note: REFERENCE, not a trigger table. Read this to know what capabilities exist and to phrase a benefit in beginner-friendly words; decide what fits the user's task by reasoning fresh each turn, never by matching a stored scenario. user_only=true: only the user can type it (offer it). user_only=false: Claude can do it directly (do it, don't recommend). leverage=high marks powerful capabilities a beginner likely doesn't know to ask for.
